svg.aria-label: FedEx GitHub-Hosted Azure-Integrated Ephemeral Runners Architecture Diagram
svg.text: ✓ Reduced Complexity | ✓ Reduced Operational Costs | ✓ Potential Cost Savings | ✓ Reduced Security Risks
GitHub manages runner lifecycle. Ephemeral VMs destroyed after each job. vNICs injected into your delegated subnet for private network access.
vNIC = Virtual Network Interface Card | PE = Private Endpoint | NSG = Network Security Group | AKS = Azure Kubernetes Service
